instruction: Use the opened Autodesk Revit environment and its automation interfaces to export the completed model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. Before starting the work, use `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe` as the Revit entry point for this automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The current model is a three-storey arts academy shell with a strong rectangular frame. The school wants each level reorganized into exactly five spaces on each floor, ordered along the long X axis as Studio A, Studio B, Critique, Workshop, and Store, while preserving the frame, the floor stack, and a simple pitched roof that unifies the whole building.
